summary: Nissan Auto Receivables Company II LLC filed a Form 8-K reporting an ordinary auto-loan securitization: the 2026-B Owner Trust issued $1.285 billion of asset-backed notes across Class A-1 through Class C, described in a prospectus dated September 22, 2026. No special-situation event is present; filings consist solely of the prospectus disclosure and Mayer Brown legality and tax opinions. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, stake, or regulatory clock applies. The risk-arb angle is nil; monitoring centers on ABS spread and credit performance of the receivables pool.
